# 指标 毁伤仿真 —— 直接粘贴到新算子库 pythonInput 节点
# 逻辑：① 筛攻击任务与目标 ② 每目标取最大毁伤/100 ③ 被摧毁目标先置 1 ④ 与模板阈值比较 ⑤ 输出明细表
# 契约：input_df_dict / prev_output_df / pd / np 由引擎注入；结束必须给 output_df 赋 DataFrame
import pandas as pd 
import numpy as np

def T(name):
    # 兼容数据模板表名带或不带 .csv 后缀
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    # 安全取列：缺列时返回等长默认值，空表也能跑通
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

missions = T("MissionChanged")
rels = T("MissionUnitRelationChanged")
damaged = T("UnitDamaged")
losses = T("Losses")
units = T("UnitCreated")

COLS = ["目标ID", "目标名", "所属任务ID", "所属任务名", "目标损伤程度", "损伤比不小于", "完成打击目标"]

# ① 筛 Strike 且非 Air_Intercept 的任务；目标取 Type = StrikeActiveUnit
if missions.empty or "MissionID" not in missions.columns:
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
else:
    mask = (C(missions, "MissionClass").astype(str) == "Strike") & (C(missions, "SubClass").astype(str) != "Air_Intercept")
    sel = missions.loc[mask, ["MissionID"]].copy()
    sel["MissionName"] = C(missions, "MissionName", missions["MissionID"]).loc[sel.index]
    if rels.empty or not {"MissionID", "UnitID", "Type"}.issubset(rels.columns):
        targets = pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])
    else:
        targets = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "StrikeActiveUnit", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel, on="MissionID", how="inner")

    if targets.empty:
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        # ② 同一目标多次命中取 DamagePercent 最大值，0~100 归一到 0~1；无毁伤记录填 0
        if not damaged.empty and {"UnitID", "DamagePercent"}.issubset(damaged.columns):
            dmg = pd.to_numeric(damaged["DamagePercent"], errors="coerce").groupby(damaged["UnitID"]).max() / 100.0
            targets["目标损伤程度"] = targets["UnitID"].map(dmg).fillna(0.0)
        else:
            targets["目标损伤程度"] = 0.0

        # ③ 彻底战损（Losses.SubjectID）先强制置 1，注意此步在阈值比较之前
        lost = set(losses["SubjectID"].dropna()) if not losses.empty and "SubjectID" in losses.columns else set()
        targets.loc[targets["UnitID"].isin(lost), "目标损伤程度"] = 1.0

        # ④ 指标模板「损伤比不小于」，未配置回退 0.5；完成 = 毁伤 >= 阈值
        targets["损伤比不小于"] = 0.5
        targets["完成打击目标"] = targets["目标损伤程度"] >= targets["损伤比不小于"]

        # ⑤ 关联 UnitCreated 补目标名，输出二维表
        names = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID").set_index("UnitID")["UnitName"] if not units.empty and {"UnitID", "UnitName"}.issubset(units.columns) else pd.Series(dtype=object)
        output_df = pd.DataFrame({
            "目标ID": targets["UnitID"],
            "目标名": targets["UnitID"].map(names).fillna(targets["UnitID"]),
            "所属任务ID": targets["MissionID"],
            "所属任务名": targets["MissionName"],
            "目标损伤程度": targets["目标损伤程度"],
            "损伤比不小于": targets["损伤比不小于"],
            "完成打击目标": targets["完成打击目标"]
        })[COLS]

# 指标 单攻击任务指标 —— 直接粘贴到新算子库 pythonInput 节点
# 逻辑：① 筛 Strike 任务 ② 统计投入/目标/摧毁/命中 ③ 毁伤与模板阈值 ④ 5s 窗口算持续时间 ⑤ 完成判定
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def T(name):
    # 兼容数据模板表名带或不带 .csv 后缀
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    # 安全取列：缺列时返回等长默认值
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

missions = T("MissionChanged")
rels = T("MissionUnitRelationChanged")
losses = T("Losses")
damaged = T("UnitDamaged")
positions = T("UnitPositions")

COLS = ["任务ID", "任务名", "分方", "投入单元", "目标数", "摧毁目标数", "命中目标数", "持续时间", "完成打击目标比", "完成比"]

# ① 筛选攻击任务
if missions.empty or "MissionID" not in missions.columns:
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
else:
    mask = (C(missions, "MissionClass").astype(str) == "Strike") & (C(missions, "SubClass").astype(str) != "Air_Intercept")
    sel = missions.loc[mask].copy()
    if sel.empty:
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        name_ser = C(sel, "MissionName", sel["MissionID"])
        side_ser = C(sel, "UnitSide" if "UnitSide" in sel.columns else "Side", "未知").fillna("未知")

        # ② 投入单元（Assigned）与目标清单（StrikeActiveUnit），均只保留打击任务
        rel_ok = not rels.empty and {"MissionID", "UnitID", "Type"}.issubset(rels.columns)
        assigned = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "Assigned", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel[["MissionID"]], on="MissionID") if rel_ok else pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])
        targets = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "StrikeActiveUnit", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel[["MissionID"]], on="MissionID") if rel_ok else pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])
        assigned_cnt = assigned.groupby("MissionID").size() if not assigned.empty else pd.Series(dtype=int)
        target_cnt = targets.groupby("MissionID").size() if not targets.empty else pd.Series(dtype=int)

        # ③ 毁伤：最大 DamagePercent/100 → 未命中填 0 → 被摧毁先置 1 → 与默认阈值 0.5 比较
        lost = set(losses["SubjectID"].dropna()) if not losses.empty and "SubjectID" in losses.columns else set()
        if not targets.empty:
            if not damaged.empty and {"UnitID", "DamagePercent"}.issubset(damaged.columns):
                dmg = pd.to_numeric(damaged["DamagePercent"], errors="coerce").groupby(damaged["UnitID"]).max() / 100.0
                targets["DamagePercent"] = targets["UnitID"].map(dmg).fillna(0.0)
            else:
                targets["DamagePercent"] = 0.0
            targets.loc[targets["UnitID"].isin(lost), "DamagePercent"] = 1.0
            targets["Succ"] = targets["DamagePercent"] >= 0.5
            lost_cnt = targets[targets["UnitID"].isin(lost)].groupby("MissionID").size()
            hit_cnt = targets[targets["DamagePercent"] > 0].groupby("MissionID").size()
            succ_rate = targets.groupby("MissionID")["Succ"].mean()
        else:
            lost_cnt = hit_cnt = succ_rate = pd.Series(dtype=float)

        # ④ 持续时间：5s 重采样，任务内"至少一个投入单元有位置记录"的段数 N，取 (N-1)*5 秒
        seconds = {}
        if not assigned.empty and not positions.empty and {"Time", "UnitID"}.issubset(positions.columns):
            pos = positions[["Time", "UnitID"]].copy()
            pos["Time"] = pd.to_datetime(pos["Time"], errors="coerce")
            pos = pos.dropna(subset=["Time"]).merge(assigned[["MissionID", "UnitID"]].drop_duplicates(), on="UnitID")
            if not pos.empty:
                per_unit = {uid: g.set_index("Time").resample("5s").size() for uid, g in pos.groupby("UnitID")}
                for mid, g in pos.groupby("MissionID"):
                    series = [per_unit[u].rename(str(u)) for u in g["UnitID"].unique() if u in per_unit]
                    if series:
                        presence = pd.concat(series, axis=1).fillna(0).sum(axis=1)
                        seconds[mid] = max(0, int((presence > 0).sum()) - 1) * 5.0
                    else:
                        seconds[mid] = 0.0

        # ⑤ 组装宽表：完成打击目标比 = Succ 均值；完成比 = 完成打击目标比 >= 1
        base = pd.DataFrame({"任务ID": sel["MissionID"], "任务名": name_ser, "分方": side_ser})
        base["投入单元"] = base["任务ID"].map(assigned_cnt).fillna(0).astype(int)
        base["目标数"] = base["任务ID"].map(target_cnt).fillna(0).astype(int)
        base["摧毁目标数"] = base["任务ID"].map(lost_cnt).fillna(0).astype(int)
        base["命中目标数"] = base["任务ID"].map(hit_cnt).fillna(0).astype(int)
        base["持续时间"] = base["任务ID"].map(seconds).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
        base["完成打击目标比"] = base["任务ID"].map(succ_rate).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
        base["完成比"] = (base["完成打击目标比"] >= 1.0).astype(float)
        output_df = base[COLS]

# 指标 多攻击任务综合指标 —— 直接粘贴到新算子库 pythonInput 节点
# 逻辑：① 取 1.1.2 单任务表（流式管道用 prev_output_df，独立运行时自动重算） ② 按分方求均值 ③ 输出展示的 3 项
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def T(name):
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

COLS = ["分方", "平均完成比", "任务平均时长", "平均派遣单元数量"]

# ① 优先使用上游节点产物；独立粘贴时从原始表重算所需列
base = prev_output_df if isinstance(prev_output_df, pd.DataFrame) and not prev_output_df.empty else None
if base is None or not {"分方", "完成比", "持续时间", "投入单元"}.issubset(base.columns):
    missions = T("MissionChanged")
    rels = T("MissionUnitRelationChanged")
    losses = T("Losses")
    damaged = T("UnitDamaged")
    positions = T("UnitPositions")
    if missions.empty or "MissionID" not in missions.columns:
        base = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        mask = (C(missions, "MissionClass").astype(str) == "Strike") & (C(missions, "SubClass").astype(str) != "Air_Intercept")
        sel = missions.loc[mask].copy()
        side_ser = C(sel, "UnitSide" if "UnitSide" in sel.columns else "Side", "未知").fillna("未知")
        rel_ok = not rels.empty and {"MissionID", "UnitID", "Type"}.issubset(rels.columns)
        assigned = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "Assigned", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel[["MissionID"]], on="MissionID") if rel_ok else pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])
        targets = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "StrikeActiveUnit", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel[["MissionID"]], on="MissionID") if rel_ok else pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])
        lost = set(losses["SubjectID"].dropna()) if not losses.empty and "SubjectID" in losses.columns else set()
        if not targets.empty:
            dmg = pd.to_numeric(damaged["DamagePercent"], errors="coerce").groupby(damaged["UnitID"]).max() / 100.0 if not damaged.empty and {"UnitID", "DamagePercent"}.issubset(damaged.columns) else pd.Series(dtype=float)
            t = targets.copy()
            t["d"] = t["UnitID"].map(dmg).fillna(0.0)
            t.loc[t["UnitID"].isin(lost), "d"] = 1.0
            rate = (t["d"] >= 0.5).groupby(t["MissionID"]).mean()
        else:
            rate = pd.Series(dtype=float)
        seconds = {}
        if not assigned.empty and not positions.empty and {"Time", "UnitID"}.issubset(positions.columns):
            pos = positions[["Time", "UnitID"]].copy()
            pos["Time"] = pd.to_datetime(pos["Time"], errors="coerce")
            pos = pos.dropna(subset=["Time"]).merge(assigned[["MissionID", "UnitID"]].drop_duplicates(), on="UnitID")
            per = {u: g.set_index("Time").resample("5s").size() for u, g in pos.groupby("UnitID")} if not pos.empty else {}
            for mid, g in pos.groupby("MissionID"):
                ss = [per[u].rename(str(u)) for u in g["UnitID"].unique() if u in per]
                if ss:
                    presence = pd.concat(ss, axis=1).fillna(0).sum(axis=1)
                    seconds[mid] = max(0, int((presence > 0).sum()) - 1) * 5.0
        acnt = assigned.groupby("MissionID").size() if not assigned.empty else pd.Series(dtype=int)
        base = pd.DataFrame({
            "分方": side_ser,
            "完成比": sel["MissionID"].map(rate).fillna(0.0).ge(1.0).astype(float),
            "持续时间": sel["MissionID"].map(seconds).fillna(0.0),
            "投入单元": sel["MissionID"].map(acnt).fillna(0).astype(int)
        })

# ② 按分方取均值（源码对该表全部数值列求 mean，界面只展示下方 3 项）
if base is None or base.empty or "分方" not in base.columns:
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
else:
    g = base.copy()
    for c in ["完成比", "持续时间", "投入单元"]:
        g[c] = pd.to_numeric(g.get(c, 0.0), errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    out = g.groupby("分方", dropna=False).agg(
        平均完成比=("完成比", "mean"),
        任务平均时长=("持续时间", "mean"),
        平均派遣单元数量=("投入单元", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    # ③ 输出界面展示的 3 项综合指标
    output_df = out[COLS]

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import math

def T(name):
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

def dist_to_line(x, y, coords):
    # 点到折线的最短距离（度），等价于 shapely Point.distance(LineString)
    best = float("inf")
    for i in range(len(coords) - 1):
        x1, y1 = coords[i]
        x2, y2 = coords[i + 1]
        dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
        den = dx * dx + dy * dy
        t = 0.0 if den == 0 else max(0.0, min(1.0, ((x - x1) * dx + (y - y1) * dy) / den))
        best = min(best, math.hypot(x - (x1 + t * dx), y - (y1 + t * dy)))
    return best

CORRIDOR_DEG = 0.5  # 航线邻域容限（严格小于）
missions = T("MissionChanged")
refpoints = T("MissionRefPointRelationChanged")
rels = T("MissionUnitRelationChanged")
positions = T("UnitPositions")
losses = T("Losses")
units = T("UnitCreated")
COLS = ["单元ID", "单元名", "所属任务ID", "任务名", "进入阵位时间", "离开阵位时间", "保持阵位秒数", "损失"]

if missions.empty or "MissionID" not in missions.columns:
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
else:
    has_ref = set(refpoints["MissionID"].dropna()) if not refpoints.empty and "MissionID" in refpoints.columns else set()
    sel = missions.loc[(C(missions, "MissionClass").astype(str) == "Support") & missions["MissionID"].isin(has_ref)].copy()
    name_by_mid = dict(zip(sel["MissionID"], C(sel, "MissionName", sel["MissionID"])))
    geos = {}
    if not refpoints.empty and {"MissionID", "Type", "Longitude", "Latitude"}.issubset(refpoints.columns):
        for mid, g in refpoints.loc[C(refpoints, "Type").astype(str) == "NavigationCourse"].groupby("MissionID"):
            pts = [(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in zip(pd.to_numeric(g["Longitude"], errors="coerce"), pd.to_numeric(g["Latitude"], errors="coerce")) if pd.notna(a) and pd.notna(b)]
            if len(pts) >= 2:
                geos[mid] = pts
            elif len(pts) == 1:
                geos[mid] = [pts[0], pts[0]]
    rel_ok = not rels.empty and {"MissionID", "UnitID", "Type"}.issubset(rels.columns)
    assigned = rels.loc[rels["Type"] == "Assigned", ["MissionID", "UnitID"]].merge(sel[["MissionID"]], on="MissionID") if not sel.empty and rel_ok else pd.DataFrame(columns=["MissionID", "UnitID"])

        pos = pos.dropna(subset=["Time", "UnitID", "UnitLongitude", "UnitLatitude"]).merge(assigned[["MissionID", "UnitID"]].drop_duplicates(), on="UnitID")
        pos["_in"] = False
        for mid, line in geos.items():
            idx = pos.index[pos["MissionID"] == mid]
            if len(idx):
                pos.loc[idx, "_in"] = [dist_to_line(a, b, line) < CORRIDOR_DEG for a, b in zip(pos.loc[idx, "UnitLongitude"], pos.loc[idx, "UnitLatitude"])]
        for (mid, uid), g in pos[pos["_in"]].groupby(["MissionID", "UnitID"]):
            unit_series[(mid, uid)] = g.set_index("Time").resample("5s").size()

    # ③ 首/末时间、保持时长与损失标记
    names = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID").set_index("UnitID")["UnitName"] if not units.empty and {"UnitID", "UnitName"}.issubset(units.columns) else pd.Series(dtype=object)
    rows = []
    for (mid, uid), s in unit_series.items():

            "所属任务ID": mid,
            "任务名": name_by_mid.get(mid, mid),
            "进入阵位时间": s.first_valid_index() if len(s) else pd.NaT,
            "离开阵位时间": s.last_valid_index() if len(s) else pd.NaT,
            "保持阵位秒数": len(s) * 5.0,
            "损失": uid in lost

    output_df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=COLS)[COLS] if rows else pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)

# 指标 单元杀伤链闭环 —— 直接粘贴到新算子库 pythonInput 节点
# 逻辑：① 四节点各取 groupby().first() ② 以 UnitCreated 全量为底表左连接 ③ 发现时间回填
#       ④ 闭环时间 = 毁伤 - 发现，闭环 = 该差值非空（不要求四点齐全/有序） ⑤ 输出宽表 + 责任节点
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def T(name):
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

def first_series(df, key, time_col="Time"):
    # 与源码一致：不按时间排序，groupby().first() 取表中首行
    if df.empty or key not in df.columns or time_col not in df.columns:
        return pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]", name="Time")
    d = df.copy()
    d[time_col] = pd.to_datetime(d[time_col], errors="coerce")
    return d.groupby(key)[time_col].first().rename_axis("UnitID")

DET_STATUS = {"KnownDomain", "KnownType", "KnownClass", "PreciseID"}
IDT_STATUS = {"KnownClass", "PreciseID"}
det = T("DetectionIdentificationChanged")
eng = T("EngagementCycle")
fired = T("WeaponFired")
destroyed = T("UnitDestroyed")
endgame = T("WeaponEndgame")
units = T("UnitCreated")
COLS = ["目标ID", "目标名", "目标型号", "分方", "发现时间", "识别时间", "齐射时间", "毁伤时间", "杀伤闭环总时长", "是否闭环", "发现平台", "识别平台", "齐射单元", "致命武器"]

# ① 增强探测表：ContactID -> ContactActualUnitID 映射（内连接）
if not det.empty and "ContactID" in det.columns:
    d = det.copy()
    if "ContactActualUnitID" not in d.columns and not eng.empty and {"ContactID", "ContactActualUnitID"}.issubset(eng.columns):
        cmap = eng[["ContactID", "ContactActualUnitID"]].dropna().drop_duplicates("ContactID")
        d = d.merge(cmap, on="ContactID", how="inner")
    if "ContactActualUnitID" not in d.columns:
        d["ContactActualUnitID"] = d["ActualUnitID"] if "ActualUnitID" in d.columns else d["ContactID"]
    if "Time" in d.columns:
        d["Time"] = pd.to_datetime(d["Time"], errors="coerce")
    d_status = C(d, "IdentificationStatus").astype(str) if "IdentificationStatus" in d.columns else pd.Series("KnownClass", index=d.index)
    d_det = d.loc[d_status.isin(DET_STATUS)]
    d_idt = d.loc[d_status.isin(IDT_STATUS)]
    t_det = first_series(d_det, "ContactActualUnitID").rename("DetectionTime")
    t_idt = first_series(d_idt, "ContactActualUnitID").rename("IdentificationTime")
    det_node = d_det.groupby("ContactActualUnitID").first()["SensorPlatformName"].rename("发现平台") if "ContactActualUnitID" in d_det.columns and "SensorPlatformName" in d_det.columns else pd.Series(dtype=object, name="发现平台")
    idt_node = d_idt.groupby("ContactActualUnitID").first()["SensorPlatformName"].rename("识别平台") if "ContactActualUnitID" in d_idt.columns and "SensorPlatformName" in d_idt.columns else pd.Series(dtype=object, name="识别平台")
else:
    t_det = pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]", name="DetectionTime")
    t_idt = pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]", name="IdentificationTime")
    det_node = pd.Series(dtype=object, name="发现平台")
    idt_node = pd.Series(dtype=object, name="识别平台")

# 齐射 / 摧毁 / 致命武器三个节点
fkey = "TargetContactActualUnitID" if "TargetContactActualUnitID" in fired.columns else ("TargetID" if "TargetID" in fired.columns else None)
t_fire = first_series(fired, fkey).rename("FiringTime") if fkey else pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]", name="FiringTime")
fire_node = fired.groupby(fkey).first()["FiringUnitName"].rename("齐射单元") if fkey and "FiringUnitName" in fired.columns else pd.Series(dtype=object, name="齐射单元")
t_dest = first_series(destroyed, "UnitID").rename("DestroyedTime") if "UnitID" in destroyed.columns else pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]", name="DestroyedTime")
if not endgame.empty and {"TargetID", "Result"}.issubset(endgame.columns) and "WeaponName" in endgame.columns:
    weapon_node = endgame.loc[endgame["Result"].astype(str) == "KILL"].groupby("TargetID").first()["WeaponName"].rename("致命武器")
else:
    weapon_node = pd.Series(dtype=object, name="致命武器")

# ② 底表 = UnitCreated 全部行（不做类型过滤）+ 出现在这四组节点中的其它 ID
ids = []
if not units.empty and "UnitID" in units.columns:
    ids.extend(units["UnitID"].dropna().tolist())
for s in [t_det, t_idt, t_fire, t_dest]:
    ids.extend(list(s.index))
ids = list(dict.fromkeys(ids))
chain = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(ids, name="UnitID"))
for ser in [t_det, t_idt, t_fire, t_dest, det_node, idt_node, fire_node, weapon_node]:
    if len(ser):
        chain = chain.join(ser, how="left")
for col in ["DetectionTime", "IdentificationTime", "FiringTime", "DestroyedTime"]:
    if col not in chain.columns:
        chain[col] = pd.NaT
    chain[col] = pd.to_datetime(chain[col], errors="coerce")
for col in ["发现平台", "识别平台", "齐射单元", "致命武器"]:
    if col not in chain.columns:
        chain[col] = np.nan

# ③ 发现时间回填：缺失或晚于识别时间时，用识别侧整体覆盖（源码覆盖 4 个字段，这里覆盖时间与平台）
fix_mask = chain["DetectionTime"].isna() | (chain["DetectionTime"] > chain["IdentificationTime"])
chain.loc[fix_mask, "DetectionTime"] = chain.loc[fix_mask, "IdentificationTime"]
chain.loc[fix_mask, "发现平台"] = chain.loc[fix_mask, "识别平台"]

# ④ 闭环时间 = 毁伤 - 发现；闭环判定只看这个差值是否非空
chain["杀伤闭环总时长"] = (chain["DestroyedTime"] - chain["DetectionTime"]).dt.total_seconds()
chain["是否闭环"] = chain["杀伤闭环总时长"].notna()

# ⑤ 补目标属性并输出宽表
info = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID").set_index("UnitID") if not units.empty and "UnitID" in units.columns else pd.DataFrame()
def attr(col, default):
    # 缺值时用等长 Series 兜底，避免向 fillna 传入 Index 触发 TypeError
    fb = pd.Series(default, index=chain.index)
    if col in info.columns:
        s = pd.Series(chain.index.map(info[col]), index=chain.index)
        return s.fillna(fb)
    return fb
chain["目标ID"] = chain.index.astype(str)
chain["目标名"] = attr("UnitName", chain.index.astype(str))
chain["目标型号"] = attr("UnitClass", "未知型号")
chain["分方"] = attr("UnitSide", "未知")
# 四个节点时间改用中文列名输出（与 UI 明细表一致）
chain["发现时间"] = chain["DetectionTime"]
chain["识别时间"] = chain["IdentificationTime"]
chain["齐射时间"] = chain["FiringTime"]
chain["毁伤时间"] = chain["DestroyedTime"]
output_df = chain.reset_index(drop=True)[COLS] if len(chain) else pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)

# 时间列转字符串：平台结果预览不支持 Timestamp/NaT 直接序列化
for c in ["发现时间", "识别时间", "齐射时间", "毁伤时间"]:
    output_df[c] = pd.to_datetime(output_df[c], errors="coerce").dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").fillna("")

        t_idt = d.loc[st.isin({"KnownClass", "PreciseID"})].groupby("ContactActualUnitID")["Time"].first()
    else:

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import math

def T(name):
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

def radar_horizon_nm(detection_alt_m, target_alt_m=40.0):
    # 源码 radar_horizon_nm_ref 公式；按算法本意首参是探测方高度(米)，目标高度固定 40 m
    a = max(0.0, float(detection_alt_m))
    d1 = math.sqrt(12742000.0 * a + a * a)
    d2 = math.sqrt(12742000.0 * target_alt_m + target_alt_m * target_alt_m)
    return (d1 + d2) / 1852.0

def union_area_m2(circles, grid=60):
    # 网格近似 unary_union 后的覆盖面积（平方米），circles: (x, y, radius_m, course_deg, is360)
    if not circles:
        return 0.0
    xmin = min(c[0] - c[2] for c in circles)
    xmax = max(c[0] + c[2] for c in circles)
    ymin = min(c[1] - c[2] for c in circles)
    ymax = max(c[1] + c[2] for c in circles)
    if xmax <= xmin or ymax <= ymin:
        return 0.0
    gx = (np.linspace(xmin, xmax, grid + 1)[:-1] + np.linspace(xmin, xmax, grid + 1)[1:]) / 2
    gy = (np.linspace(ymin, ymax, grid + 1)[:-1] + np.linspace(ymin, ymax, grid + 1)[1:]) / 2
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(gx, gy)
    covered = np.zeros(X.shape, dtype=bool)
    for cx, cy, r, course, is360 in circles:
        mask = (X - cx) ** 2 + (Y - cy) ** 2 <= r * r
        if not is360:
            # ⑤ 扇形：以航向为中心 ±60° 走廊近似（源码由 SB1/SB2/SMF1 位标记决定）
            bearing = 90.0 - np.degrees(np.arctan2(Y - cy, X - cx))
            diff = (bearing - float(course) + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
            mask = mask & (np.abs(diff) <= 60.0)
        covered = covered | mask
    cell = ((xmax - xmin) / grid) * ((ymax - ymin) / grid)
    return float(covered.sum() * cell)

    sc = sc[sc["_active"] & (sc["_status"] == "Operational")]
    sc["_maxrange"] = pd.to_numeric(C(sc, "SensorMaxRange", 0), errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    sc["_is360"] = C(sc, "SensorHas360Coverage", True).astype(str).isin(["True", "1", "true", "1.0"])
    radar = sc[["UnitID", "_maxrange", "_is360"]].drop_duplicates("UnitID")

    # ① 位置重采样到 1 分钟 + 末条复制补点（仅当距终止时刻 > 5 秒）
    tick_times = pd.to_datetime(C(tick, "Time", pd.NaT), errors="coerce") if not tick.empty else pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]")
    t_end = tick_times.max() if len(tick_times) and tick_times.notna().any() else pd.NaT
    dest_time = {}
    if not destroyed.empty and {"UnitID", "Time"}.issubset(destroyed.columns):
        dd = destroyed.copy()
        dd["Time"] = pd.to_datetime(dd["Time"], errors="coerce")
        dest_time = dd.dropna(subset=["Time"]).groupby("UnitID")["Time"].first().to_dict()
    num_cols = [c for c in ["UnitLongitude", "UnitLatitude", "UnitCourse", "UnitAltitude_m"] if c in positions.columns]
    frames = []
    if not positions.empty and {"Time", "UnitID"}.issubset(positions.columns) and num_cols:
        p = positions[["Time", "UnitID"] + num_cols].copy()
        p["Time"] = pd.to_datetime(p["Time"], errors="coerce")
        for c in num_cols:
            p[c] = pd.to_numeric(p[c], errors="coerce")
        p = p.dropna(subset=["Time", "UnitID"])
        p = p[p["UnitID"].isin(set(radar["UnitID"]))]
        for uid, g in p.groupby("UnitID"):
            s = g.set_index("Time")[num_cols].resample("1min").mean().interpolate("index")
            target = dest_time.get(uid, t_end)
            if len(s) and pd.notna(target) and abs((s.index[-1] - target).total_seconds()) > 5:
                s.loc[target] = s.iloc[-1]
                s = s.sort_index()
            s["UnitID"] = uid
            frames.append(s.reset_index())
    rs = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) if frames else pd.DataFrame(columns=["Time", "UnitID"] + num_cols)

    uside = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID").set_index("UnitID")["UnitSide"] if not units.empty and {"UnitID", "UnitSide"}.issubset(units.columns) else pd.Series(dtype=object)
    if rs.empty:
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        rs["_side"] = rs["UnitID"].map(uside).fillna("未知")
        rs = rs.merge(radar, on="UnitID", how="inner")
        records = []
        for (t, side), g in rs.groupby(["Time", "_side"], dropna=False):
            lat0 = float(pd.to_numeric(g.get("UnitLatitude", 0.0), errors="coerce").fillna(0.0).mean())
            lon0 = float(pd.to_numeric(g.get("UnitLongitude", 0.0), errors="coerce").fillna(0.0).mean())
            m_per_lon = 111320.0 * max(0.01, math.cos(math.radians(lat0)))
            circles = []
            for _, row in g.iterrows():
                # ④ 有效探测距离 = min(最大量程, 雷达地平线)；按本意传 UnitAltitude_m
                alt = float(row.get("UnitAltitude_m", 0.0)) if "UnitAltitude_m" in g.columns and pd.notna(row.get("UnitAltitude_m")) else 0.0
                eff = min(float(row["_maxrange"]), radar_horizon_nm(alt))
                cx = (float(row.get("UnitLongitude", lon0)) - lon0) * m_per_lon
                cy = (float(row.get("UnitLatitude", lat0)) - lat0) * 111320.0
                course = float(row.get("UnitCourse", 0.0)) if "UnitCourse" in g.columns and pd.notna(row.get("UnitCourse")) else 0.0
                circles.append((cx, cy, eff * 1852.0, course, bool(row["_is360"])))
            # ⑥ 并集面积（平方米），绘图时 /1e6 转平方公里
            area = union_area_m2(circles)
            records.append({"分方": side, "时间": t, "面积_平方米": round(area, 2), "面积_平方公里": round(area / 1.0e6, 4)})
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=COLS)[COLS]

# 时间列转字符串：平台结果预览不支持 Timestamp/NaT 直接序列化
output_df["时间"] = pd.to_datetime(output_df["时间"], errors="coerce").dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").fillna("")

# 逻辑：① 以 UnitType != Group 的全集重算"被发现"中间表 ② 每方加上己方全部单元 ③ 呈现率 = 呈现/全部
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def T(name):
    return input_df_dict.get(name, input_df_dict.get(name + ".csv", pd.DataFrame()))

def C(df, name, default=None):
    return df[name] if name in df.columns else pd.Series(default, index=df.index, dtype=object)

units = T("UnitCreated")
contacts = T("ContactCreated")
sides_df = T("SideCreated")
COLS = ["分方", "呈现单元数", "所有单元数", "态势呈现率"]

if units.empty or "UnitID" not in units.columns:
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
else:
    u = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID")
    side_col = "UnitSide" if "UnitSide" in u.columns else ("Side" if "Side" in u.columns else None)
    u["_side"] = C(u, side_col, "未知") if side_col else "未知"
    # ① 只排除 Group（武器也算进态势完整度），与发现率的 Aircraft/Ship 口径不同
    universe = u[~C(u, "UnitType").astype(str).eq("Group")].copy() if "UnitType" in u.columns else u.copy()
    actual_ids = set(contacts["ActualUnitID"].dropna()) if not contacts.empty and "ActualUnitID" in contacts.columns else set()
    universe["_detected"] = universe["UnitID"].isin(actual_ids)
    mid = universe.groupby("_side", dropna=False).agg(Detected=("_detected", "sum"), Considered=("_detected", "size"))

    side_list = []
    if not sides_df.empty and "SideName" in sides_df.columns:
        side_list.extend(sides_df["SideName"].dropna().tolist())
    side_list.extend(mid.index.tolist())
    side_list = list(dict.fromkeys(side_list))
    total_all = int(mid["Considered"].sum())

    records = []
    for side in side_list:
        # ② 己方单元全部已知：Detection 与 Considered 同时加上己方单元数
        own = int(mid["Considered"].get(side, 0))
        others = mid[mid.index != side]
        known = int(others["Detected"].sum()) + own
        considered = int(others["Considered"].sum()) + own
        denom = considered if considered else total_all
        # ③ 呈现率（分母为全场被考虑单元数，排除 Group）
        records.append({"分方": side, "呈现单元数": known, "所有单元数": denom,
                        "态势呈现率": round(known / denom, 4) if denom else 0.0})
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=COLS)[COLS]

    tick_times = pd.to_datetime(C(tick, "Time", pd.NaT), errors="coerce").dropna() if not tick.empty else pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]")

    info = units.drop_duplicates("UnitID").set_index("UnitID") if not units.empty and "UnitID" in units.columns else pd.DataFrame()

    records = []
    for uid, g in uj.sort_values("Time").groupby("UnitID"):
        g = g.sort_values("Time")
        ts = []
        # ② 首条变更不是 jammed（开局即被干扰）→ 补推演起点；末条仍是 jammed → 补被毁/推演终点
        if not bool(g.iloc[0]["_jammed"]):
            ts.append(t_begin)
        ts.extend(g["Time"].tolist())
        if bool(g.iloc[-1]["_jammed"]):
            ts.append(dest_time.get(uid, t_end))
        if len(ts) % 2 != 0:

        s = pd.Series(pd.to_datetime(ts))

        name, side = uid, "未知"

        records.append({"单元ID": uid, "单元名": name, "分方": side, "累计受扰秒数": round(duration, 2)})

    if not records:
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        out = pd.DataFrame(records)
        if "UnitType" in info.columns:
            out = out[out["单元ID"].map(info["UnitType"]).ne("Group")]  # 排除动态 Group

else:
    hf = comm.copy()
    if not comm_class.empty and {"CommDBID", "HF_Radio"}.issubset(comm_class.columns) and "CommDBID" in hf.columns:
        hf = hf.merge(comm_class[["CommDBID", "HF_Radio"]].drop_duplicates("CommDBID"), on="CommDBID", how="left")
        mask = C(hf, "HF_Radio", False).astype(str).str.lower().isin(["true", "1", "1.0"])
        hf = hf[mask]
    else:
        hf = hf.iloc[0:0]
    tick_times = pd.to_datetime(C(tick, "Time", pd.NaT), errors="coerce").dropna() if not tick.empty else pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]")

    if not destroyed.empty and {"UnitID", "Time"}.issubset(destroyed.columns):

        dest_time = dd.dropna(subset=["UnitID", "Time"]).sort_values("Time").groupby("UnitID")["Time"].first().to_dict()

    # ② 只处理有状态变化记录的网台；与 6.1 相同的交替区间积分

        state = state.dropna(subset=["CommID", "Time"])

        operating = (end - t_begin).total_seconds() if pd.notna(end) and pd.notna(t_begin) else 0.0

            "分方": side_map.get(info.get("UnitID"), "未知") if hasattr(side_map, "get") else "未知"
        })
    output_df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=COLS)[COLS] if rows else pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)

    d = d.merge(units[ucols].drop_duplicates("UnitID"), on="UnitID", how="inner") if "UnitID" in d.columns else d.iloc[0:0]
    d["Distance"] = pd.to_numeric(C(d, "Distance", np.nan), errors="coerce")
    # ② 只保留地面防空单元
    d = d[C(d, "UnitType").astype(str).isin(["Facility", "Vehicle"])]
    side_col = "UnitSide" if "UnitSide" in d.columns else ("Side" if "Side" in d.columns else None)
    d["_side"] = C(d, side_col, "未知") if side_col else "未知"
    d["_dbid"] = C(d, "UnitDBID", "未知").astype(str)
    d["_class"] = C(d, "UnitClass", "未知型号").fillna("未知型号")
    if d.empty:
        output_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=COLS)
    else:
        # ③ 按 (分方, 型号 DBID) 取 max
        out = d.groupby(["_side", "_dbid"], dropna=False).agg(
            最大探测距离_海里=("Distance", "max"), 型号=("_class", "first")
        ).reset_index()
        output_df = pd.DataFrame({
            "型号": out["型号"],
            "分方": out["_side"],
            "最大探测距离_海里": out["最大探测距离_海里"].round(2)
        })[COLS]
